extracted.name: Spicy Glazed Carrots
extracted.description: Sweet and spicy carrots cooked with brown sugar, cinnamon, cayenne pepper, and nutmeg make a flavorful and easy side dish that’s great with fall meals.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
instruction_lines: Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add carrots, brown sugar, cinnamon, cayenne pepper, and nutmeg; cook and stir until carrots are glazed, coated with spices, and tender, 10 to 15 minutes.
